summary: Bug-verification retest for FakeCursor crash. Main agent rewrote FakeCursor to hold the active step object in state keyed by screen id, and Rail now consumes an opacity motion value. Stress-scrolled 1920x1080: 3 full cycles of fast forward through all 5 chapters + reverse to hero, plus 2 smooth-scroll forward/back passes. Captured both pageerror and console errors -> 0 page errors, 0 console errors. Confirmed no 'undefined is not an object (evaluating at.x)'. Regression checks all pass: fake-cursor shows during chapters and is absent at hero; chapter-rail opacity ~1 during chapters, ~0 at hero; nav-item-<id>, window-url ('crowned.com / <id>') and caption-<id> with 01/05..05/05 index all correct for every chapter; marquee, how-it-works, faq (items expand), closing, footer all render; no horizontal overflow at 1920x1080 or 390x844.
critical_code_review_comments: FakeCursor fix is clean: component is keyed by shot.id (<FakeCursor key={shot.id} screenId={shot.id} .../>) and stores the step object (not an index). The early return `if (!shown || !at) return null` guards the first frame, and the fallback `steps[0] || null` protects against an unknown screen id. Race condition eliminated.

Minor: Rail fade-out window is very narrow (EXIT_START to EXIT_START+0.04 = 0.98 -> 1.02 vs scroll clamp 1.0), so at the very bottom of the film the rail still shows ~0.5 opacity before the section ends. Cosmetic only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug from iteration_1 (FakeCursor at.x crash) is fully resolved via keyed remount + step-object state. No further action needed on this page.
